name: Standard Chartered
verdict: About 18% owned by Temasek, Singapore’s state investment company.
note: Re-rated 2026-09-27 (docs/rating-review-2026-09-27.md): Temasek (wholly owned by the Singapore government) holds 17-18%; Singapore counts as a state with a record (maintainers, September 2026). The sanctions record in the old claim is not a human-rights finding.

why.text: Singapore’s state investment company Temasek is Standard Chartered’s largest shareholder, with about 18%. Singapore carried out 17 executions in 2025, 15 of them for drug offences, and UN human rights experts have condemned its executions for drug offences as unlawful. So part of the money behind Standard Chartered is the Singapore state’s.
why.messageLine: Singapore carried out 17 executions in 2025, 15 of them for drug offences.
